stages.title: Systems Foundations
stages.subtitle: Build the operating-system and shell fluency every later tool assumes.
courses: The command line, filesystems, processes, networking, services, security, and production troubleshooting.
Portable command-line automation, pipelines, functions, error handling, and production shell practices.
Object-oriented automation for Windows, Linux, cloud platforms, and infrastructure operations.

stages.title: Version Control & Collaboration
stages.subtitle: Manage change, review work, and coordinate software delivery.
courses: Distributed version control from commits and branches to recovery, internals, and enterprise workflows.
Repositories, pull requests, issues, security, releases, organizations, packages, and collaboration governance.
Repository collaboration, project governance, registries, security controls, and integrated delivery workflows.

stages.title: Build & Artifact Management
stages.subtitle: Turn source code into reproducible, versioned, distributable artifacts.
courses: Java and JVM build lifecycles, dependency management, testing, packaging, and CI integration.
Host and govern packages, proxy upstream registries, promote builds, and manage artifact lifecycles.

stages.title: Testing & Code Quality
stages.subtitle: Automate confidence before software reaches production.
courses: Cross-browser end-to-end automation with WebDriver, Grid, containers, and CI pipelines.
Keyword-driven acceptance testing, reusable libraries, reports, and CI execution.
Load, stress, endurance, and API performance tests with repeatable non-GUI execution.
Quality profiles, issues, coverage, security hotspots, and enforceable quality gates.

stages.title: Continuous Integration & Delivery
stages.subtitle: Build, test, approve, and release software through automated pipelines.
courses: Workflow syntax, runners, matrices, caching, environments, reusable workflows, and deployments.
Jobs, stages, runners, artifacts, environments, security scans, and delivery orchestration.
Pipeline-as-code, agents, credentials, plugins, shared libraries, and reliable enterprise automation.

stages.title: Containers & Platforms
stages.subtitle: Package workloads consistently and operate them at scale.
courses: Images, Dockerfiles, registries, Compose, networking, storage, security, and production builds.
Workloads, services, storage, scheduling, configuration, security, scaling, and cluster operations.
Charts, templates, values, releases, dependencies, testing, and maintainable deployment packages.
Projects, routes, operators, security constraints, builds, GitOps, and platform operations.

stages.title: Infrastructure & Configuration
stages.subtitle: Provision environments and keep machines in a known, repeatable state.
courses: Providers, state, modules, plans, environments, remote backends, testing, and safe change workflows.
Inventories, playbooks, roles, variables, idempotency, secrets, and fleet automation.
Reproducible virtual-machine labs, provisioning, networking, snapshots, and multi-machine environments.
Declarative resources, manifests, modules, catalogs, agents, PuppetDB, and enterprise operations.
Cookbooks, recipes, resources, testing, policyfiles, nodes, and infrastructure automation.
Master/minion architecture, states, pillars, orchestration, events, and high-speed fleet control.

stages.title: Web Delivery & Networking
stages.subtitle: Route traffic, terminate TLS, proxy services, and expose applications safely.
courses: HTTP serving, reverse proxying, load balancing, TLS, caching, rate limits, and observability.

stages.title: DevSecOps & Secrets
stages.subtitle: Find risk early and control sensitive access throughout delivery.
courses: Scan images, filesystems, dependencies, IaC, Kubernetes resources, licenses, and secrets.
Secret engines, policies, authentication, dynamic credentials, PKI, transit encryption, and operations.

stages.title: GitOps Delivery
stages.subtitle: Continuously reconcile declared deployment state from Git.
courses: Applications, sync policies, health, projects, multi-cluster delivery, rollbacks, and progressive workflows.

stages.title: Monitoring, Logging & Observability
stages.subtitle: Understand system behavior through metrics, logs, alerts, and operational context.
courses: Scraping, exporters, labels, PromQL, recording rules, alerting, federation, and Kubernetes monitoring.
Dashboards, variables, transformations, alerting, provisioning, and multi-source observability.
Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana, ingest pipelines, lifecycle management, and observability use cases.
Host and service checks, plugins, notifications, dependencies, availability, and legacy estate monitoring.
Search processing language, field extraction, dashboards, alerts, log analytics, and security use cases.

stages.title: Cloud Platforms
stages.subtitle: Apply the complete toolchain on the three major public-cloud ecosystems.
courses: Identity, networking, compute, storage, containers, automation, monitoring, security, and cost controls.
Entra ID, virtual networks, compute, containers, pipelines, monitoring, policy, and governance.
IAM, VPC, compute, GKE, Cloud Build, observability, security, and cost management.
